name: integration-contract
purpose: The package exposes a framework-agnostic headless core, a thin React integration, controlled and uncontrolled state, and safe server rendering.

given.text: the shortcut core is imported without a UI framework

when.text: the core and React integration are imported in a server-rendering context

then.text: importing does not require browser globals
the React integration accepts caller-controlled shortcut state
the React integration can manage shortcut state internally
the integration does not require package-defined styling
